title: Maps to a constant group scheme are clopen decompositions
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $E$ be an abelian group, and let $T_E=\coprod_{e\in E}T$ be the constant group scheme over $T$, with coprojections $\iota_e:T\to T_E$, components $V_e=\iota_e(T)$, structure morphism $\pi:T_E\to T$, sum $f+g$ of $T$-morphisms and canonical map $e\mapsto c_e$ as in [def-weil-pbc-constant-group-scheme] (a $T$-scheme in the sense of [def-weil-scheme-over-base]). For every object $s:U\to T$ of the small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], giving a $T$-morphism $f:U\to T_E$ is equivalent to giving a family of pairwise disjoint open-and-closed subschemes $(U_e\subseteq U)_{e\in E}$ whose union is $U$: the bijection sends $f$ to $(f^{-1}(V_e))_{e\in E}$, and its inverse sends $(U_e)$ to the unique morphism $f$ with $f|_{U_e}=\iota_e\circ s|_{U_e}$ for all $e$ (only finitely many $U_e$ are nonempty when $U$ is quasi-compact). Equivalently it is a map $\varphi:|U|\to E$ whose fibres are open and closed (equivalently, open), namely $\varphi_f(x)=e\iff f(x)\in V_e$. Under this equivalence, the canonical map $E\to h_{T_E}(U)=\operatorname{Mor}_T(U,T_E)$, $e\mapsto c_e=\iota_e\circ s$, sends $e$ to the morphism with $U_e=U$ and $U_{e'}=\varnothing$ for $e'\ne e$, hence to the constant map with value $e$; and the group law is pointwise addition: $\varphi_{f+g}=\varphi_f+\varphi_g$. In particular $f\mapsto\varphi_f$ is an isomorphism of $\operatorname{Mor}_T(U,T_E)$, with the sum of [def-weil-pbc-constant-group-scheme], onto the abelian group of maps $|U|\to E$ with open fibres under pointwise addition, and $e\mapsto c_e$ is a group homomorphism. (The etaleness of $U\to T$ is not used: the statement holds for every $T$-scheme $U$.)

proof.text: Apply coproductCopiesMorphismsClopen to obtain the decomposition and locally constant equivalences. The restriction formula, compact finite range and coproduct universal property give all decomposition clauses. Mathlib proves open fibres are clopen. Transfer the pointwise abelian group structure across the locally constant equivalence. Component-addition compatibility identifies transported addition with the scheme-theoretic sum; canonical points are constants and hence give an additive homomorphism.

lean.statement: theorem constantGroupSchemeMorphismsClopen (T U : Scheme.{u}) (E : Type v) [Small.{u} E] [AddCommGroup E] (s : U ⟶ T) : (∃ b : ConstantGroupSchemePoint T E s ≃ {P : E → U.Opens // IsClopenDecomposition U E P}, (∀ f e, ((b f).1 e : Set U) = f.1 ⁻¹' constantGroupSchemeComponent T E e) ∧ (∀ (P : {P : E → U.Opens // IsClopenDecomposition U E P}) (e : E), (P.1 e).ι ≫ (b.symm P).1 = ((P.1 e).ι ≫ s) ≫ constantGroupSchemeIncl T E e) ∧ (∀ (P : {P : E → U.Opens // IsClopenDecomposition U E P}) (e : E), IsClopen (P.1 e : Set U)) ∧ (∀ P : {P : E → U.Opens // IsClopenDecomposition U E P}, IsCompact (Set.univ : Set U) → Set.Finite {e : E | (P.1 e : Set U).Nonempty}) ∧ (∀ e₀ e, (b (constantGroupSchemeCanonicalMap T E s e₀)).1 e = if e = e₀ then ⊤ else ⊥) ∧ (∀ P : {P : E → U.Opens // IsClopenDecomposition U E P}, ∃! f : ConstantGroupSchemePoint T E s, ∀ e, (P.1 e).ι ≫ f.1 = ((P.1 e).ι ≫ s) ≫ constantGroupSchemeIncl T E e)) ∧ (∀ φ : U → E, (∀ e, IsOpen (φ ⁻¹' {e})) ↔ (∀ e, IsClopen (φ ⁻¹' {e}))) ∧ (∃ a : AddCommGroup (ConstantGroupSchemePoint T E s), letI := a (∀ f g : ConstantGroupSchemePoint T E s, f + g = constantGroupSchemePointAdd T E s f g) ∧ ∃ Φ : ConstantGroupSchemePoint T E s ≃+ LocallyConstant U E, (∀ f x e, Φ f x = e ↔ f.1 x ∈ constantGroupSchemeComponent T E e) ∧ (∀ e, Φ (constantGroupSchemeCanonicalMap T E s e) = LocallyConstant.const U e) ∧ (∀ f g x, Φ (constantGroupSchemePointAdd T E s f g) x = Φ f x + Φ g x) ∧ ∃ c : E →+ ConstantGroupSchemePoint T E s, ∀ e, c e = constantGroupSchemeCanonicalMap T E s e)
